# cw bash completion — generated by `cw completion bash`.
# Install: eval "$(cw completion bash)"  (e.g. in ~/.bashrc)
_cw_complete() {
  local cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
  if [ "$COMP_CWORD" -eq 1 ]; then
    COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "help doctor list search info init plan status next dispatch result state commit report app sandbox backend contract node feedback worker audit loop schedule routine registry run queue clones orphans history quickstart audit-run metrics operator sched gc telemetry migration demo workbench ledger graph man version fix completion check" -- "$cur") )
  fi
}
complete -F _cw_complete cw
